mainTopic: The opening משנה of יבמות: fifteen women forbidden to the יבם as ערוה exempt themselves, their צרות, and the צרות of their צרות from חליצה and יבום forever.
overview: The first משנה of מסכת יבמות sets out a basic rule. When a man dies without children, his brother (the יבם) normally must do יבום or חליצה with the widow. But if the widow is one of fifteen close relatives the יבם may never marry (an ערוה), she is exempt from both. So is her צרה (her co-wife from the dead brother), and even the צרה of that צרה, with no end to the chain. The משנה then starts listing the fifteen women. First come the יבם's own daughter and granddaughters, and his wife's daughter and granddaughters. Next come his mother-in-law and his wife's two grandmothers. Then come his maternal half-sister, his mother's sister, his wife's sister, and the wife of his maternal half-brother. That makes thirteen, and the list continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Fifteen forbidden women exempt their co-wives forever
steps.stepSummary: The משנה states the main rule: fifteen women who are ערוה to the יבם exempt their צרות, and the צרות of those צרות, from חליצה and יבום forever.
steps.simpleTranslation: There are fifteen women who free their co-wives, and their co-wives' co-wives, from חליצה and from יבום, forever.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה opens the whole מסכת with a general rule: some widows are so closely related to the יבם that not only they, but also their co-wives, are freed from יבום and חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Normally a childless widow must either do יבום with the brother or be released through חליצה. If she is an ערוה to the brother, the מצוה does not apply to her at all. The new point is that her צרה is also fully exempt, and that exemption keeps passing down a chain of co-wives with no limit.

keyTerms.meaning: A co-wife; another wife of the same husband
The ceremony that releases a widow from the obligation of יבום
Levirate marriage: the brother marries his childless brother's widow
Literally 'until the end of the world'; here it means the chain never stops

steps.confusionAlert: The surprise here is the צרה. She is not related to the יבם at all, yet she is still fully exempt, without even חליצה, only because she shared a husband with an ערוה.
steps.whyThisMatters: This rule that a צרה is treated like the ערוה herself runs through the whole first פרק. The גמרא will later ask where it comes from in the Torah.

phrases.english: their co-wives and the co-wives of their co-wives
phrases.notes: The 'co-wife of a co-wife' is the other wife of a later brother. The first צרה married that brother in יבום and was then widowed again.

phrases.english: until the end of the world.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opening of the מסכת; nothing comes before it.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An ערוה of the יבם, her צרה, and every later צרה of a צרה are exempt from both יבום and חליצה.

steps.title: The list begins: his descendants and his wife's descendants
steps.stepSummary: The משנה begins listing the fifteen: the יבם's daughter, daughter's daughter, and son's daughter, and his wife's daughter, her son's daughter, and her daughter's daughter.
steps.simpleTranslation: These are the women: his daughter, his daughter's daughter, his son's daughter, his wife's daughter, his wife's son's daughter, and his wife's daughter's daughter.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה starts naming the fifteen women. The first six are the יבם's own female descendants and his wife's female descendants.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In each case, the dead brother had married this woman. That was allowed for him, since she is only his niece or a relative through his brother's wife. Now she falls to his brother, and for the brother she is a daughter, granddaughter, or stepdaughter, which is an ערוה. So she cannot do יבום, and that exempts her צרה too.

keyTerms.meaning: And these are they; this opens the list

steps.confusionAlert: Every 'his' in this list means the living brother, the יבם, not the dead husband. The woman was married to the dead brother, and she is related to the brother who is left.

phrases.english: And these are they: his daughter
phrases.notes: This means the יבם's own daughter, who had married her uncle, the brother who died.

phrases.english: and his daughter's daughter, and his son's daughter
and her son's daughter, and her daughter's daughter

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts spelling out who the 'fifteen women' of step 1 are.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The יבם's daughter and granddaughters, and his wife's daughter and granddaughters, are among the fifteen exempting women.

steps.title: The list continues: his in-laws
steps.stepSummary: The next three women on the list are the יבם's mother-in-law, his mother-in-law's mother, and his father-in-law's mother.
steps.simpleTranslation: His mother-in-law, his mother-in-law's mother, and his father-in-law's mother.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues the list with the יבם's in-laws from the generations above his wife.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first group was his wife's descendants. Now the משנה moves up to his wife's ancestors. A man may never marry his wife's mother or grandmothers, so if one of them was married to the dead brother, she is an ערוה to the יבם and is exempt.

phrases.english: his mother-in-law, and his mother-in-law's mother

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the list from step 2, moving from the wife's descendants to her ancestors.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The יבם's mother-in-law and his wife's grandmothers are among the fifteen exempting women.

steps.title: The list continues: sisters, an aunt, and a maternal brother's wife
steps.stepSummary: The list adds the יבם's maternal half-sister, his mother's sister, his wife's sister, and the wife of his maternal half-brother. The list continues past this point.
steps.simpleTranslation: His sister from his mother, his mother's sister, his wife's sister, and the wife of his brother from his mother.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה keeps listing forbidden women. It adds four relatives through his mother, his wife, and his maternal brother. The list is not finished yet.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word 'from his mother' is exact. A sister from his father would also be the dead brother's sister, so the dead brother could never have married her. A sister from his mother only is not related to the dead brother, who shares only their father. Likewise, a brother from his mother only is not a 'brother' for יבום, so his widow is simply an ערוה to the יבם. She could have later married the dead paternal brother, and she now comes before the יבם as an ערוה.

keyTerms.meaning: His maternal half-sister: same mother, different father
His wife's sister; forbidden while his wife is alive
The wife of his maternal half-brother

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the brothers. יבום applies only between brothers from the same father. The 'brother from his mother' in the last case is a different person from the dead husband who triggers the יבום.

phrases.english: and the wife of his brother from his mother,

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲחוֹתוֹ מֵאִמּוֹ, וַאֲחוֹת אִמּוֹ, וַאֲחוֹת אִשְׁתּוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the list from step 3 with relatives through his mother, his wife, and his maternal brother.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The יבם's maternal half-sister, his maternal aunt, his wife's sister, and his maternal half-brother's wife are also among the fifteen exempting women.
